clips.title: The story
paras: Horde defenders hold Far Watch Post west of the Southfury River bridge, guarding the homeland's frontier. The outpost protects vital trade caravans from quilboar packs and Alliance incursions.

Far Watch Post guards the western foot of the bridge from Durotar into the Barrens. You enter a vast, arid savannah, where this is the first sign of Horde authority. The settlement is spare but built for readiness, with an orcish watchtower, a burrow, and siege catapults aimed across the plains. South of the main road, peons tend riding wolves for messengers or reinforcements. The post keeps the supply road to Crossroads secure, screening travelers and turning back raids by roaming quilboar tribes and Alliance scouts.
